O.content: The top of the red bar above "Huawei" is higher on the page than the tops of the orange Apple, dark-blue Samsung, green Xiaomi, and blue Others bars.
The visible y-axis is labeled from 0 at the bottom upward through 10-point ticks to 100 near the top.

B.text: If the bars encode market_share by vertical height on the shared y-axis, with higher bar tops meaning larger values, then the tallest bar identifies the current market-share leader; under the stated promotion policy, select that leader.
B.conditions: Applies only if the y-axis and bar geometry are authoritative despite conflicting percentage inscriptions.

O.content: The x-axis label "Apple" is centered below the leftmost orange bar, and the inscription "30%" appears directly above that bar.
The x-axis label "Samsung" is centered below the dark-blue bar, and the inscription "11%" appears directly above that bar.
The x-axis label "Xiaomi" is centered below the green bar, and the inscription "11%" appears directly above that bar.
The x-axis label "Huawei" is centered below the red bar, and the inscription "23%" appears directly above that bar.
The x-axis label "Others" is centered below the rightmost blue bar, and the inscription "25%" appears directly above that bar.

B.text: If each percentage inscription placed immediately above a brand's bar is the dashboard's authoritative market_share value for that x-axis brand, then those inscriptions can be compared to identify the current market-share leader; under the stated promotion policy, select that leader.
B.conditions: Applies only if the printed percentage labels, rather than the plotted bar heights against the y-axis, are authoritative market_share encodings.
